note: Team coding of the BASS as-run notes (PSI-26). Each event is one action the crew took on a burning sample and what the note says happened next. The quote is copied word for word from the run's note in data/runs.json so a person can check the coding. Nothing here is a NASA classification.
sourceFile: BASS test matrix.xlsx (PSI-26), sheet 'as run matrix', notes column
rules: Only actions whose result is stated in the note are coded. If the note does not say what the flame did, there is no event.
airflow-stopped: the fan, air or flow was turned off.
airflow-reduced: the flow was turned down but not off. Fan dial and pot settings are kept as written and never converted to cm/s.
nitrogen: the nitrogen jet was turned on the flame.
airflow-increased: the fan was turned up to try to blow the flame off.
went-out: the note says the flame went out after the action. kept-burning: the note says it did not. partly-out: part of the flame went out and part stayed.
Flames that went out because the fuel ran out are not coded.
